text: Auditing and Logging in the Cloud — the one log every governance program in this chapter has quietly depended on.
Collected automatically, no configuration needed. And the initiator isn't always a person — Azure Policy Insights shows up here whenever a policy's effect actually fires.
For a subset of operations, Change history goes further — the actual before and after values, like a VM's power state moving from stopped to running.
CloudTrail's Event history is the AWS equivalent — same 90-day default window, filtered here to writes and state changes only.
Filtering to ConsoleLogin is one of the first things an incident investigation does — confirming exactly who signed in, and when.
That closes Chapter Four. Next: multi-cloud governance — running both of these models at once.
